The '''Sarkhai''' were a people native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarkhai/Legends|Sarkhai]].<ref name="Codex Sarkhai" /> [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were uncommon among the Sarkhai,<ref name="Codex Grell">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nadia Grell (Consular)}}</ref> so much so that [[Nadia Grell]] was the only one known to have the abilities on her entire planet, though word of a child with similar traits reached her ears after she became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to the [[Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

The Sarkhai tradition of face-painting developed as a way to frighten the predators of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Codex Sarkhai" />

In order to protect themselves against the great dangers on their planet, the Sarkhai developed highly sophisticated defensive technology<ref name="Codex Sarkhai" /> that made them sought after for alliance. Upon joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Rift Alliance]] recruited the Sarkhai into their fold and the [[Children of the Emperor]] wanted them to join the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], in order to get their technology.
